title: Managing stores
summary: KloudC masters: store statuses, suspend, resume, archive and retry set-up.

items: **Setup failed**: provisioning stopped. Retry set-up continues from the failed step.
**Suspended**: sign-in is refused, the store's jobs stop and the app shows a maintenance message. Data is kept.
**Archived**: off-boarded. Sign-in is refused and the store answers like an unknown one. Data is kept until it is purged.
**Suspend** asks for a reason, which is recorded.
**Resume** turns a suspended store back on at once.
**Archive** needs you to type the Store ID to confirm.
Open a store to see and change its settings in a side panel. See [Store settings](article:master-store-settings).

blocks.text: Every action is written to the audit log with your name.
